title.narrative: Strengthening journalism’s capacity to support environmental sustainability and expose corruption, via journalist networks and civic engagement

description.narrative:
Impact: Protection of the world's oceans and rainforests and the rights of people affected by their destruction, and advanced dialogue among decision makers about the transparency of governments, companies, and financial institutions. Outcome 1: Increased quantity and quality of breakthrough journalism with audience-centered strategies on rainforests, oceans, and transparency. Outcome 2: Increases in the quantity and quality of discussion about covered issues among key target audiences, through a stronger and better informed civil society that can advocate for improved policies.
The funds are committed in agreement QZA-23/0109, with a total grant of NOK 170.3 million, also including funds on programme area 03 from two different chapter posts on oceans and governance. Due to technical constraints on combining programme areas 03 and 12 on the same agreement in PTA, the rainforest funds are registered on a separate agreement. Governance, with particular focus on illicit financial flows, is also cross-cutting in the sectors covered by the project (rainforests and oceans).
